findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_now, create_watch, check_web_page, watch_web_page, check_rss_feed, watch_rss_feed, check_crypto_price, watch_crypto_price, check_sec_filings, watch_sec_filings, check_insider_trades, watch_insider_trades, check_x402_endpoint, watch_x402_endpoint · Private data: check_now, create_watch, check_web_page, watch_web_page, check_rss_feed, watch_rss_feed, check_crypto_price, watch_crypto_price, check_sec_filings, watch_sec_filings, check_insider_trades, watch_insider_trades, check_x402_endpoint, watch_x402_endpoint, poll_alerts, try_watch · Public sink: check_now, create_watch, check_web_page, watch_web_page, check_rss_feed, watch_rss_feed, check_crypto_price, watch_crypto_price, check_sec_filings, watch_sec_filings, check_insider_trades, watch_insider_trades, check_x402_endpoint, watch_x402_endpoint · Destructive: poll_alerts, delete_watch.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
